name: Allbirds, Inc. (NASDAQ: BIRD) / NewBird AI
description: Financial forensics investigation of Allbirds, Inc. (NASDAQ: BIRD) and its April 15, 2026 rebrand to "NewBird AI" — a pivot from struggling sustainable footwear retailer to purported "GPU-as-a-Service" AI compute provider. The announcement triggered a ~600% one-day stock surge (from ~$3 to ~$16.99) on a $50M convertible financing from an undisclosed institutional investor. Investigation focuses on: (1) who is the undisclosed convertible counterparty and what are the conversion terms; (2) insider trading around the March 30 shoe-asset-sale and April 15 AI-pivot announcements; (3) the role of placement agent Chardan Capital Markets (SEC-sanctioned 2018 for penny-stock SAR failures) and whether this exhibits toxic/death-spiral financing hallmarks; (4) how the pattern compares to Long Island Iced Tea -> Long Blockchain Corp (2017), which resulted in SEC insider-trading charges against three individuals and delisting in 2021. CIK: 0001785450. Ticker: BIRD. Delaware incorporation; HQ San Francisco, CA.

name: Sam Altman
description: Investigation of Sam Altman — OpenAI CEO, venture capital networks, personal financial vehicles, and related entities including Structure Fund I GP, LLC.

name: Kenny Chesney
description: Investigation into Kenny Chesney's boat/vessel ownership — identifying holding companies, vessel names, and registration details.

name: Tim Draper
description: Investigation of the Silicon Valley VC / Russian tech / quantum computing nexus centered on DFJ and Draper Associates. Originated from FBI ARMS Reach vetting memo filed under OPERATION TRIP KNOT (OCDETF Eurasian Organizations, Case 243H-WF-2182018). Key vectors: Masha Drokova bridge between Putin/Nashi, Epstein, and SV tech; Frank Creer parallel blackmail operation via Sanctum club; QWave/Runa Capital Russian oligarch connections; Ukraine sanctions lobbying with Caputo.

name: Jeffrey Epstein
description: Network investigation rooted in the Epstein case, following evidence across connected structures — Mega Group, Deutsche Bank, Gulf states, Israeli intelligence, Apollo/Black financial flows, and parallel networks.

name: Aetna-Epstein-Apollo corporate network (N722JE helicopter transaction)
description: Investigation of the July 2011 sale of Sikorsky S-76C++ N722JE from Jeffrey Epstein's shell company Freedom Air International, Inc. to Aetna's wholly- owned aviation subsidiary ASI Wings, LLC for $11,900,000 (with $11,800,000 wired to JPMorgan Chase in Panama), the June 2019 no-consideration transfer of the same helicopter back to Epstein's USVI entity Hyperion Air, LLC twenty-three days before Epstein's arrest, and the broader Aetna-Epstein- Apollo corporate network surfaced by that transaction — including Jeffrey D. Benjamin's simultaneous roles as Apollo Global Management Senior Advisor and Chiquita Brands Board Audit Committee member (2002-2007) during and after Fernando Aguirre's Chiquita CEO tenure, and Aguirre's appointment to Aetna's Board and Audit Committee on 2011-07-29 (three days after the Panama wire).

name: Feeding Our Future fraud scheme
description: Investigation of Feeding Our Future and the broader Minnesota federal child nutrition fraud scheme. Focus on sponsor-site networks, shell entities, money laundering, state oversight failures, and criminal case progression. As of September 4, 2025, DOJ had charged 75 defendants in a scheme alleging roughly 91 million fake meals and nearly $250 million stolen from pandemic-era federal nutrition programs.

name: John Hagee
description: Investigation of Pastor John Hagee's financial empire, political influence network, and institutional infrastructure spanning Cornerstone Church, Christians United for Israel (CUFI), John Hagee Ministries, and affiliated entities. Focus on financial flows, real estate holdings, political relationships, and cross-entity governance.

name: Foreign private issuer insider filing sweep
description: Investigation of the first-wave Section 16 reporting now required from directors and officers of foreign private issuers after the Holding Foreign Insiders Accountable Act took effect on March 18, 2026. Focus on building a triaged issuer universe from new Forms 3, 4, and 5; prioritizing small- and mid-cap issuers with resale pressure, offshore opacity, hype-sector promotion, or governance anomalies; and turning the filing wave into accountability reporting leads.

name: Manosphere monetization ecosystem
description: Investigation of the online manosphere / red-pill commercial ecosystem: creators, paid communities, coaching offers, supplements, crypto or trading products, affiliate networks, and the corporate/payment infrastructure that supports them. Focus on mapping the ecosystem, testing public commercial claims against records, and surfacing leads around deceptive practices, hidden ownership, platform migration, and regulatory risk.

name: Mike Johnson (Speaker of the House)
description: Investigation of Rep. James Michael Johnson (R-LA), 56th Speaker of the US House. Focus: evangelical dark money network, financial disclosure violations, housing arrangements, ADF legal career, campaign finance.

name: NGINX / NGINX Inc
description: Investigate Russian influence over NGINX through corporate control, developer governance, and potential code-level backdoors or vulnerabilities. Covers NGINX Inc (Delaware), Runa Capital investment, F5 acquisition, Rambler raid, and open source contributor network.

name: Timothy C. Parlatore
description: Investigation of Timothy C. Parlatore, founder of Parlatore Law Group. Focus: Naval Reserve commissioning loophole allowing him to work for the Pentagon under SecDef Pete Hegseth while maintaining private practice; conflicts of interest representing clients suing the Pentagon while serving inside it; alleged payments from officers seeking promotion; prior Trump legal team role in the classified documents case; representation of high-profile military and political clients (Eddie Gallagher, Bernard Kerik).

name: Lockheed Martin Peru Defense Sale
description: Investigation of the recent Lockheed Martin defense sale to Peru and the surrounding political upheaval — including the Castillo impeachment (2022), the Boluarte presidency and her removal, the José Jerí caretaker government, and the procurement decision-making chain. Focus areas: who decided, who benefited, what intermediaries/lobbyists were involved, FCPA exposure, competing bids (Saab Gripen, Dassault Rafale), and financial/political beneficiaries. Treat all named procurement officials, intermediaries, and Peruvian political figures as unverified until corroborated against primary sources.

name: Super Micro Computer, Inc.
description: Financial forensics investigation of Super Micro Computer (SMCI). Prototype case to validate Hindenburg-style investigation capabilities: related-party transactions, accounting manipulation, corporate structure tracing, officer network analysis, and regulatory history. CIK: 0001375365. Ticker: SMCI. Incorporated in Delaware, HQ in San Jose, CA.

name: Silicon Valley Defense Complex
description: Investigation of the Silicon Valley-to-Pentagon pipeline under the second Trump administration. Tracks revolving door appointments (Emil Michael, Pete Hegseth), defense tech capture (SpaceX, Anduril, Palantir, D-Wave), DOGE government restructuring, and conflicts of interest where tech investors shape defense policy that benefits their portfolios. Focus on financial flows, government contracts, ethics waivers, and institutional capture mechanisms.

name: Paolo Zampolli
description: Investigation into Paolo Zampolli — Italian-born businessman, founder of ID Models (NY DOS #2202863, filed 1997, dissolved 2009), UN Ambassador for the Commonwealth of Dominica, Trump Organization Director of International Development (2004-2006), and current US Special Envoy for Global Partnerships. Central figure connecting the New York modeling industry, real estate, diplomacy, and Republican political circles.
